project_type: Fullstack monorepo - Next.js 15 frontend + NestJS backend for car/motorcycle rental platform
test_framework: Jest for backend, Vitest for frontend
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install at root. 2. Run pnpm build to verify both apps compile. 3. Run pnpm test to verify tests pass. 4. Run pnpm lint to check code quality.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client generated via prisma generate in apps/api/
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install at repo root. 2. Copy .env.example to .env in apps/web and apps/api. 3. Run prisma generate in apps/api.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22, pnpm 10.x available. MySQL not installed - use SQLite for local dev/testing with Prisma. Full internet access available.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield - establishing conventions with this implementation.
key_patterns: Monorepo with apps/web (Next.js 15 App Router) and apps/api (NestJS). Shared packages in packages/ directory. Prisma ORM for database. shadcn/ui components. TailwindCSS styling. Mobile-first responsive design.
directory_structure: / (root) - pnpm-workspace.yaml, turbo.json, package.json | apps/web/ - Next.js 15 frontend | apps/api/ - NestJS backend | packages/shared/ - shared types/utils | packages/ui/ - shared UI components
